title: TimePicker
description: A time selection component with dropdown list or analog clock face variant, supporting 12h/24h formats and min/max time constraints.

defaultValue.description: Default time value for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (time: string | null, timeValue: TimeValue | null) => void — Called when the selected time changes.

onBlur.description: () => void — Called when the input loses focus.

minuteStep.description: Minute interval for dropdown options and clock snapping. Clamped to 1-60.

name.description: Name for the hidden input for form submission.

error.description: Marks the component as having an error.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the input.

description.description: React.ReactNode — Helper text displayed below the label.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Label displayed above the input.

required.description: Shows a required indicator on the label.

showEndIcon.description: Show the chevron/end icon in the trigger.

endIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom end icon element replacing the default chevron.

showSelectedIcon.description: Show a check icon on the selected option.

renderOptionContent.description: (time: string, isSelected: boolean) => ReactNode — Custom renderer for dropdown option content.

fullWidth.description: Expand the picker to fill its parent container.

variant.description: Visual variant: dropdown list or analog clock face.

clearable.description: Show a clear button when a value is selected.

onClear.description: () => void — Called when the clear button is clicked.

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void — Called when the open state changes.

lockScroll.description: Lock body scroll when dropdown is open.

dropdownPosition.description: Position of the dropdown relative to the trigger.

forceDropdownPosition.description: When true, locks the dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping.

dropdownGap.description: Gap between trigger and dropdown in pixels.

keepMounted.description: Keep dropdown DOM mounted when closed (dropdown variant only).

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null — Custom container element for the dropdown portal.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for all sub-elements.

unstyled.description: Omits built-in layout helpers so layout comes entirely from classes.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS prefers-reduced-motion setting.

onCancel.description: () => void — Called when the clock cancel button is pressed.

onConfirm.description: () => void — Called when the clock confirm button is pressed.

cancelText.description: Text for the clock cancel button.

okText.description: Text for the clock OK button.
